summary: Computes a state flag value as 2 minus the result of sub_4F9B20, ORs in bit 4 when the parameter a1 is non-zero or byte_7CE254 (DisableHUD flag) is set, dispatches the value through CallWrapper_c060, and records a -2 dispatch result in byte_8AFE72 (audio init success flag). Returns the dispatch status code.

operations.description: Compute the base flag value v1 = 2 - sub_4F9B20().
If parameter a1 is non-zero OR byte_7CE254 (DisableHUD flag) is set, OR bit 4 into the flag value v1.
Dispatch the computed flag value through CallWrapper_c060 and store its returned status code as result.
If the dispatch returns -2, set byte_8AFE72 (audio init success flag) to 1.
